evidence_interpretation.privacy_failure_scope: Every one of the 4096 bounded records matched at least one frozen sensitive-field-key rule.
evidence_interpretation.scientific_conclusion: The selected derived aggregation has a stable bounded schema and abundant opaque session candidates, but it fails the pre-registered field-isolation Gate across the entire bounded panel and leaves notice, global lineage, statistical independence, and pointer binding unclosed. It is therefore unsuitable as a replacement train source.

option_analysis.reason: The bounded audit failed closed because all 4096 inspected records matched the frozen sensitive-key rule. Privacy and field isolation are hard source-role Gates and cannot be offset by schema validity, session count, or pointer canonicalization.

Changing the privacy rule after observing a 100 percent trigger rate would be post hoc Gate manipulation. The existing terminal audit authority permits no retry, and the replacement threshold may not be rescued by redefining sensitive fields.

Unknown or event-type count fields were explicitly provisional non-model fields. Reclassifying them after the audit would risk label, behavior, command, or nuisance leakage and would silently reverse the frozen field-isolation contract.

The metadata review already identified raw credentials, commands, URLs, environment values, network or geolocation identifiers, fingerprints, filenames, and other high-risk raw-event material. A dirtier surface cannot remediate a privacy failure in the narrower aggregation.

Transferred files may contain malicious payloads, while their metadata may expose filenames, fingerprints, URLs, or related artifact context. Neither surface is needed for label-independent session grouping and neither can repair the failed privacy Gate.
The audit sampled a bounded prefix only. It did not close global one-session-to-one-record behavior, reconnects, retries, duplicate campaigns, actor correlation, or statistical independence.
The probe established only deterministic in-memory canonicalization. Gzip random access and global source round trip remain unverified, so binding_status must remain unbound.

The committed acquisition and sanitized audit may remain as auditable negative source-gate evidence and, under separate authority, a parser or fail-closed regression fixture. The gzip object itself may not become model-visible or enter train or development.

The portfolio position must remain vacant until a distinct source passes pre-registered rights, privacy, field-isolation, lineage, pointer, and protected-exclusion Gates without post hoc rule changes or dirtier-surface substitution.

Count the 160 honeypots, four configurations, countries, days, files, event types, attacks, verdicts, or bounded-prefix lines as independent executions.
Promote 4096 bounded unique session candidates to global lineage or statistical independence.
Promote an in-memory pointer canonicalization check to a bound or source-recoverable pointer.
Use schema validity to override privacy, notice, rights, lineage, pointer, protected-overlap, or nuisance-independence Gates.

reopen_conditions: The curator publishes a new immutable record revision with a physically separate privacy-safe aggregation whose exact field allowlist excludes sensitive, label-like, event-target, command, credential, URL, filename, fingerprint, geolocation, payload, and raw-message material.
The new revision publishes machine-readable nested rights or notice metadata and a stable label-independent session manifest with duplicate, reconnect, retry, and campaign-correlation policy.
The new revision supports deterministic compressed-record pointer recovery without exposing raw session identifiers.
Any such revision must enter a new metadata candidate review and new acquisition and audit authorities. It is not a rerun or remediation of the rejected revision-6 replacement.

replacement_slot.required_evidence_shape: A distinct endpoint or provenance family with at least four source-native label-independent execution, session, run, or capture groups and a physically isolated, privacy-safe evidence surface that passes immutable rights, notice, schema, field-isolation, lineage, pointer, protected-overlap, and nuisance-independence Gates.
